spans.s: Kaumāra, adj. (“belonging to Kumāra [i.e. Skanda]”). § 358 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 82, 4086 (by living on vegetables or fruits at Āgastyaṃ saraḥ one attains to Kºṃ padaṃ).-§ 497 (Skandotpatti): III, 226, 14351 (maṅgalāni… Kºāṇi trayodaśa).--§ 615u (Skanda): IX, 46, 2655 (ºyaḥ, sc. mātaraḥ).
Kaumāra, name of a varsha in Śākadvīpa. § 575b (Śākadvīpa): VI, 11, 426.
Kaumodaki, name of the mace of Kṛshṇa. § 257 (Khāṇḍavadahanap.): I, 225, 8200 (e: capable of slaying every Daitya (Daityāntakaraṇīṃ), given to Kṛshṇa by Varuṇa).-§ 596 (Pratijñāp.): VII, 79, 2809.

Kaumuda, name of a month = Kārttika. § 562 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 83, 2926 (ºe māsi).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XII, 66, 3370 (ºe śuklapakshe).--§ 761 (do.): XIII, 115, 5656 (ºe…śuklapakshe), 5660 (ºṃ pakshaṃ), 5670 (māsaṃ).
Kaumudī, the day of full moon in the month of Kaumuda [i.e. Kārttika]. § 766 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 130, 6132.
